Roman",serif;--space-xs:0.5rem;--space-sm:1rem;--space-md:2rem;--space-lg:4rem;--max-width:1100px;--radius:0.5rem;}*{box-sizing:border-box;}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-body);background-color:var(--color-bg);color:var(--color-text);line-height:1.6;font-size:1rem;}h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-heading);color:var(--color-primary-darker);line-height:1.2;margin-top:0;}a{color:var(--color-primary-dark);text-decoration:underline;}a:hover{color:var(--color-primary-darker);}a:focus,button:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{outline:3px solid var(--color-primary-dark);outline-offset:2px;}.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.25rem;width:100%;}header{background-color:var(--color-bg-alt);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border);}.header-inner{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--space-sm);padding:1rem 1.25rem;}.logo{font-family:"Palatino Linotype","Book Antiqua",serif;font-variant:small-caps;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0.25em;font-size:clamp(1.1rem,4vw,1.6rem);color:var(--color-primary-darker);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-primary-dark);width:fit-content;padding-bottom:0.2rem;}.logo:hover{color:var(--color-primary-dark);}nav ul.nav-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-sm);margin:0;padding:0;}nav ul.nav-list a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--color-text);font-weight:600;padding:0.4rem 0.2rem;}nav ul.nav-list a:hover{color:var(--color-primary-dark);}main{display:block;}section{padding:var(--space-lg) 0;}section:nth-of-type(even){background-color:var(--color-bg-alt);}.grid{display:grid;gap:var(--space-md);grid-template-columns:1fr;}.card{background-color:var(--color-bg);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:var(--space-md);}.btn{display:inline-block;min-height:44px;padding:0.75rem 1.75rem;background-color:var(--color-primary-dark);color:#ffffff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.2;}.btn:hover{background-color:var(--color-primary-darker);color:#ffffff;}.dark-section{background-color:var(--color-dark-bg);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.dark-section h1,.dark-section h2,.dark-section h3{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.dark-section a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-sm);max-width:36rem;}label{font-weight:700;margin-bottom:0.25rem;display:block;}input,textarea,select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:0.6rem 0.75rem;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:1rem;background-color:#ffffff;color:var(--color-text);}textarea{min-height:6rem;resize:vertical;}fieldset{border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:var(--space-sm);}legend{font-weight:700;padding:0 0.5rem;}img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:var(--radius);}footer{background-color:var(--color-dark-bg);color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);padding:var(--space-md) 0;}footer a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.footer-names{font-family:var(--font-heading);font-size:1.3rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-bottom:0.5rem;}@media (max-width:600px){.header-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}nav ul.nav-list{gap:0.75rem;}section{padding:var(--space-md) 0;}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}@media (min-width:601px){.grid-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}.grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}.header-inner{flex-wrap:nowrap;}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto;}*{animation:none !important;transition:none !important;}}

pages.title: Emily & James — Wedding Invitation
pages.html:
Emily & James
  • Details
  • Our Story
  • Gallery
  • RSVP

Together with their families

Emily Harper & James Whitfield Are Getting Married

Saturday, October 18, 2025

The Willowbrook Garden Estate, Willowbrook, California

RSVP Now

Wedding Details

Date & Time

Saturday, October 18, 2025

Ceremony begins at 4:00 PM
Reception to follow at 6:00 PM

Venue

The Willowbrook Garden Estate

482 Orchard Hill Road
Willowbrook, CA 90210

Attire

Garden Formal

Soft pastels encouraged. Lawn areas are grassy — wedge or block heels recommended.

A shuttle will run between the Willowbrook Inn and the venue from 3:00 PM. Street parking is also available on Orchard Hill Road.

Our Story

How We Met

Emily and James met in the autumn of 2018 at a pottery class in downtown Willowbrook, both hiding how badly their first bowls had collapsed. Ten clumsy mugs later, they finally admitted they'd been signing up every week just to see each other.

The Proposal

Six years on, James proposed at sunrise on the same hillside where they had their first picnic, with Emily's dog Biscuit carrying the ring box on his collar. She said yes before he'd even finished the question.

Gallery

RSVP

Kindly respond by September 1, 2025. We can't wait to celebrate with you!

Will you be attending?

Emily Harper & James Whitfield

123 Maple Grove Lane, Willowbrook, CA 90210

Email: hello@emilyandjames.love · Phone: (555) 204-7788

© 2024 Emily & James. With love, always.
